citations.context: I'd be so bold as to say that's where your idea of evil comes from too, which is why you generally need your arbitrary sense of what God commands to agree with it. Now there's the problem the problem they're going to face is there is no answer. It's dangerous to say other people will never have an answer to a point you're making, especially since one of them might give the answer in a recorded response before you say it. I know what many of them will say.

citations.title: How Apologetics Sabotages Relationships

text.KJV: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
text.WEB: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
